name: io.github.Tobiz21/tobiz-mcp
title: TOBIZ MCP
description: Create, edit and audit TOBIZ websites, pages, blocks, articles and products.

environmentVariables.name: TOBIZ_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: TOBIZ account email. Prefer an existing session when available.

environmentVariables.name: TOBIZ_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: TOBIZ account password. Enter through a secret prompt, never in chat.

environmentVariables.name: TOBIZ_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated TOBIZ project IDs that this server may access.

environmentVariables.name: TOBIZ_REQUIRE_PROJECT_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Require an explicit project allowlist for all project operations.
